localizedValues.name: G1 - Group Pod 1
localizedValues.description: Smallest of the 3 group areas.  Does NOT have a picnic shelter. The beach and showerhouse trail runs next to it. This area is ideal for 5-8 average sized parties.

localizedValues.name: G2 - Group Pod 2
localizedValues.description: Picnic Shelter with some counter space, sink,wood stove and tables.  Shelter is adjacent to grass area. Has a bigger fire ring. This area is ideal for 8-12 average sized parties.

localizedValues.name: G3 - Group Pod 3
localizedValues.description: Picnic Shelter with some counter space, sink,wood stove and tables.  Shelter is adjacent to grass area. This area is ideal for 8-12 average sized parties.
